capability-manifest-certify.description: Validate the strict Brain-discoverable Agent Infrastructure capability manifest, including effect declarations, required routing surfaces and explicit absence of publication or financial authority.

autonomous-worker-routing-certify.description: Certify zero-cost Spark route selection, exhausted-capacity retention, supervised-admission continuity and paid-fallback rejection without starting a model turn.

codex-spark-capacity-status-certify.description: Certify that raw Spark capacity, supervised physical admission and short-lived dispatch eligibility remain separate exact-byte evidence classes. Available capacity cannot bypass rejected, stale, broadened or over-concurrent admission; exhausted capacity remains exhausted and paid fallback remains forbidden.

codex-candidate-change-observer-certify.description: Create a disposable local Git fixture and independently observe exact tracked patch bytes, tracked and untracked file content, index identity, staged state and unmerged state in two stable passes. Same-path byte drift, links, dirty-state drift and worker-authored HEAD movement fail closed without Codex or a model turn.

codex-worker-dispatch-binding-certify.description: Certify that the final Test Builder dispatch digest binds exact leased-work bytes, canonical route-plan bytes, allowed and forbidden path envelopes and the external deterministic-validation request while preserving zero validation, publication and paid-fallback authority.

codex-test-builder-completion-certify.description: Certify the base Test Builder completion state machine, model-summary contract, admitted path set, route-admission continuity and pre-validation authority boundary.

codex-test-builder-boundary-certify.description: Certify exact-byte continuity from leased work through route plan, bound dispatch, run receipt and stable two-pass candidate state. Patch, file-content, index, validation-request or observation-time drift fails closed before deterministic validation.

codex-worker-result-classifier-certify.description: Certify observed Codex result classification for available, exhausted, rate-limited, authentication and degraded states without querying account usage or starting a model turn.

codex-worker-runner-safety-certify.description: Prove normal Codex Spark execution remains disabled without an explicit runtime gate, digest-bound short-lived route admission and supervised physical-acceptance envelope verified against the same fresh capability receipt. Certification remains fixture-only and does not require Codex or a model turn.

codex-worker-capability-probe.description: Inspect the installed Codex CLI version and exec help, proving supported structured-output, model-selection, sandbox and approval controls without authentication mutation, model inference or repository effects.

codex-chatgpt-auth-policy-probe.description: Inspect only Codex config/requirements policy to prove ChatGPT-only login enforcement without reading credentials, API keys or starting a model turn.

codex-chatgpt-auth-policy-certify.description: Certify ChatGPT-only Codex policy detection and rejection of API/mixed/unconfigured login policies using temporary fixtures only.

codex-spark-safe-certification-contract-.description: Verify the fail-closed physical-certification supervisor, supervised-envelope binding and absence of raw/supervised effectful Spark entrypoints from the routine worker task manifest. Does not start Codex or a model turn.

codex-spark-supervised-acceptance-certif.description: Verify supervised Spark physical-acceptance envelopes, nested acceptance digests and post-cleanup truth using synthetic receipts only. Raw acceptance, tampered digests and missing cleanup evidence must fail closed.
